claim_boundary: A preregistered independent finite-roster static confirmation of fixed R8/K48-plus-single-exchange and R16/K9-plus-bulk-tie on the immutable joint95-v5 physical envelope. A pass can authorize registration of a separate envelope-normalized trajectory experiment. It does not itself run or establish trajectory behavior, prove candidate-side canonical exactness, establish action identity outside this roster, reclassify capacity, establish stability or an all-queue theorem, or establish a physical multi-GPU result.

decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_ENVELOPE_R16_BULK_TIE_STATIC: both fixed composite methods pass valid-certificate, all-load support, independent-roster exact-reference action identity, and strict per-lane plus aggregate actual-work gates
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_ACTION_IDENTITY_FAIL_: support passes but at least one candidate action differs from its exact canonical reference on the independent roster
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_COMPUTE_FAIL_STOP: support and independent-roster action identity pass, but at least one registered per-lane or aggregate work comparison is not strict
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP: execution is valid but at least one lane/load support gate fails
decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail

method_contract.candidate: one pass; for each active source replace all copies with the destination, then retain the feasible exact-score candidate with the smallest canonical key
method_contract.certificate: retain the K9 upper bound and exactness flags; update only a feasible incumbent
method_contract.charged_work: charge every structural pair check, including inactive and infeasible pairs, to candidate evaluations and residual option probes
method_contract.r8_disposition: the fixed R8/K48 single-exchange method is unchanged
method_contract.reference_independence: the polish reads no K4096 action, score, bound, or work value
method_contract.structural_pairs: all destination < source option pairs whose integer requirement sums match; the frozen nine-option model yields exactly seven pairs
method_contract.trigger: base score_exact is true and canonical_exact is false
